column8: The Shark Fin is a quest item from Act 4 acquired by defeating the "Great White One" boss on Whakapanu Island. It triggers the "Tribal Medicine" quest. To complete the quest and free up your inventory slot, give the fin to Kaimana, the tribal healer.Depending on your campaign progress, you can turn in the fin at a couple of different locations:Early Act 4: Travel directly to Ngakanu (via the boat in Kingsmarch) and hand it to Kaimana.Late Act 4/Corrupted Islands: If you have progressed too far and the island is corrupted by the weapon, you must first complete Act 4 and defeat Davakai. Afterward, you can find Kaimana on the docks and turn in the fin to receive your reward.The Reward:Turning in the Shark Fin rewards you with a choice of an Uncut Gem (either Level 11 Skill Spirit or Support gem) and a permanent stat blessing from the Tukuama tribe.For a visual guide on the exact locations of the boss and the NPC to hand it in, check out the walkthrough video below:
